note: Pinned git object sets for Z3-16 (cmd/z3git real). Nothing is committed or fetched by tests. Each repository is fetched by explicit tip SHA with a shallow depth into a bare cache outside Git; all packs are then produced locally by a single git version with explicit settings (git pack-objects), never taken from the server.
